name: io.github.chapibunny/repolens
title: RepoLens
description: Read a repository and return architecture documentation: system overview, modules, API surface, routes, dependency graph, architecture diff, and generated Markdown.

environmentVariables.name: REPOLENS_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the repository to read. Defaults to the process working directory. Every tool path must stay inside this directory.
